description: NaV₅O₁₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.85 Å. There are five inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-23°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.18 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four VO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-30°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.12 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.06 Å. In the fourth V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-30°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-2.21 Å. In the fifth V site, V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.01 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three V atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three V atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to three V atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
